TestHints: Node >= 24.18 (see package.json engines); install with `npm ci`, never update the lock file.
Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm run test:unit` (Vitest project `unit`).

Integration tests (`npm run test:int`) need PostgreSQL 17 with database `kmk_test` as in `.env.test` (DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user@localhost:5432/kmk_test); start a local postgres in the container, create role `user` and the database, then `npm run db:reset -- --test`.
E2E (`npm run test:e2e`) uses Playwright on :3100 against `kmk_test`; install browsers with `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`.
